// diagnostic

E3204

Two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `{lib}`.

What

Two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `{lib}`.

Why

A C library is brought into a file once — either `use alias: "{header}"` or `use alias: c.{lib}`, not both.

Fix

Remove one line; keep the form that matches your workflow.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3204: tests/ui/cffi_e3204_two_use_forms.stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicateCLibraryUse]: Two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `demo`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3204_two_use_forms.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     header_api: "demo.h"
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Jet allows one bring-in per C lib per file — either `use alias: "demo.h"`, `use alias: c.demo`, or `use c.[demo]`, not both
 Fix: Remove one line; keep the form that matches your workflow
